heroHeadline: UN Extends Gang Suppression Force Through March 2027 as Kidnappings Surge Ahead of December Election
heroSubtitle: On September 29, 2026 the UN Security Council voted 12-0 (China, Pakistan, Russia abstaining) to extend the Gang Suppression Force six months, to March 31, 2027, with about 1,500 of 5,500 authorized troops deployed. A gang retaliation attack killed at least 11 people after a GSF operation against illegal toll booths, and kidnappings are rising as Haiti heads toward elections on December 13.
